mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we have overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a waning crescent moon phase.

The city has announced asphalt repair work for November 9 and 10, impacting areas like Nine Mound Road and Todd Street. Additionally, the city is officially welcoming Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS department as of November 2.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, and later tonight, Art House 360 is hosting their Thursday night event. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia is happening tomorrow, and Saturday features the Dane County Farmer's Market.
On October 25, local officers conducted an investigation at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in a driver being taken into custody for an O W I offence.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
